answer.summary: The app never came up: Spring logged a fatal ERROR from SpringApplication at line 1585 and /api/me never returned 200 in 300s (HTTP 000, no listener). The exception itself is truncated in the excerpt, so the cause isn't shown. The last migration logged was V6_20261112060000000, and this PR adds migration V6_20261120160000000 plus entity and repository changes, so a deterministic boot failure from the change is more likely than infrastructure. Check the full startup stack trace for the root cause before retrying.
